mapper.select:
SELECT sc.* FROM system_codes sc
sc.parent_code_id IS NULL
AND sc.code_group = #{codeGroup}
AND sc.is_active = 1
ORDER BY sc.sort_order, sc.code_id
SELECT sc.*, p.code_name AS parent_code_name FROM system_codes sc LEFT JOIN system_codes p ON sc.parent_code_id = p.code_id WHERE sc.code_id = #{codeId}
SELECT DISTINCT code_group FROM system_codes ORDER BY code_group
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_codes (code_group, code_value, code_name, parent_code_id, sort_order, is_active, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{codeGroup}, #{codeValue}, #{codeName}, #{parentCodeId}, #{sortOrder}, #{isActive}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE system_codes SET code_name = #{codeName}, parent_code_id = #{parentCodeId}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, description = #{description}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE code_id = #{codeId}
UPDATE system_codes SET is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE code_id = #{codeId}
